Maria: Final copy pass for Hosted/Dedicated/Private landing pages. Pushed a lightweight Figma with variants: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/landing-variants
Devin: Nice. Decision: one shared subhead, mode-specific hero lines. Drafts: Hosted = 'Instant API to high-performance LLMs', Dedicated = 'Committed GPU pools, predictable SLOs', Private = 'Run inference inside your VPC'.
Sophia: Add a microline on Hosted: 'low-latency tiers + predictable pricing' (or 'cost-optimized tiers' per legal). Keep numbers off hero.
Andrew: For Dedicated CTA microcopy: 'Reserved capacity, SLA-backed performance.' One short clause beneath the CTA.
Karen: Routing rules: Hosted -> self-serve signup flow; Dedicated -> calendar booking for capacity scoping; Private -> security questionnaire + demo. Make CTAs distinct and wire UTMs.
Devin: UTM pattern suggestion: ?utm_source=website&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=cta_<mode>
Sophia: Add benchmark card on Hosted: 'Benchmarks: latency, throughput, cost per request. See results & methodology.' Link to gated slides so we can capture webinar signups.
Andrew: Webinar scheduled? @launch-bot please confirm May 12 10am PT and add to invites for benchmarking audience.
launch-bot: calendar.create_invite: "Serving LLMs at Scale" 5 May 12 10:00 PT. Hosts: Sophia, Andrew. Meeting link: https://meet.example/wv9x
Karen: Lead tagging: hosted_selfserve, dedicated_capacity, private_security; add benchmark_interest flag when they click slides. Dedicated CTA should create CRM task for Solutions Eng.
Maria: Plan: push copy tonight, copy freeze Tue EOD, dev handoff Wed morning. Everyone review by Tue 12pm PT. I'll post checklist (UTMs, CTA targets, CRM tags, cert links). :rocket:
Devin: Reviewing now.
Sophia: Reviewing benchmark blurb.
Andrew: I'll get badges/cert links for Private page.
Karen: I'll draft the funnel playbook for Dedicated.
Maria: Thanks all 680
